after.properties:
- region "Relation — Invoice → Payable":
  - heading "Relation — Invoice → Payable" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Generalization"
    - option "Realization" [selected]
    - option "Composition"
    - option "Aggregation"
    - option "Association"
    - option "Bidirectional"
    - option "Plain Assoc."
    - option "Dependency"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "Order"
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Invoice" [selected]
    - option "Payable"
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "Order"
    - option "Customer"
    - option "Invoice"
    - option "Payable" [selected]
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
